svg.text: expansion bay (4 jumper ends glued in the left wall)
PG-1 wiring, page 8 of 10: PCF8574 board -> carrier board and the expansion bay
The 4 input pins go to the board's 'expansion' header; its 4 pass-through pins go to the bay in the left wall. The PCF8574 board is stuck to the
inside of the lid with velcro.
Steps (the number is on the wire):
PCF8574: 'VCC' on the INPUT pins (left end) -> board
PCF8574: 'GND' on the INPUT pins (left end) -> board
PCF8574: 'SDA' on the INPUT pins (left end) -> board
PCF8574: 'SCL' on the INPUT pins (left end) -> board
PCF8574: 'VCC' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
expansion bay: the '3v3' place (jumper, its far end
PCF8574: 'GND' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
expansion bay: the 'gnd' place (jumper, its far end
PCF8574: 'SDA' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
expansion bay: the 'sda' place (jumper, its far end
PCF8574: 'SCL' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
expansion bay: the 'scl' place (jumper, its far end
